assurance.summary: No backup tool was detected, so recoverability is at risk.

remediationSteps.title: Install a backup solution — no backup tool detected
remediationSteps.detail: Without a backup tool, cluster recovery is not possible. Install Kasten K10, Velero, or Rubrik.
remediationSteps.whyItMatters: A DR score without any backup platform is mostly theoretical because there is no automated path to reconstruct workload data and cluster objects.
remediationSteps.drImpact: A site loss, accidental deletion, or storage failure becomes a rebuild exercise instead of a recovery exercise.
validation: Confirm whether any approved backup platform is installed in the cluster or managed externally.
Verify whether both application data and cluster-scoped configuration are covered.
fixSteps: Create production backup policies and retention settings.
Run and record a recovery drill before treating the environment as protected.
commands:
# Kasten K10 install:
helm repo add kasten https://charts.kasten.io/
helm install k10 kasten/k10 --namespace kasten-io --create-namespace

# Velero install (example with AWS S3):
velero install --provider aws --plugins velero/velero-plugin-for-aws:v1.9.0 \
  --bucket <BUCKET> --backup-location-config region=<REGION> \
  --secret-file ./credentials-velero
caveats: External enterprise backup products can exist without leaving inspectable in-cluster evidence. If that is the case, document them and verify coverage manually.
remediationSteps.targetNotes: VM target: Kasten K10 or Velero with cloud storage backend (S3, Azure Blob, GCS) are recommended.
